themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints in Sunnyside/Woodside surged to 153 THIS WEEK—a 451% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 27.8 weekly complaints—suggesting a sudden deterioration of road quality that aligns with winter weather and deferred maintenance.
evidence: 153 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 27.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.99)
Sidewalk condition complaints also spiked to 11 THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 average (203% increase, z-score: 5.24)
Snow/ice complaints remain elevated at 982 over 90 days, suggesting winter exacerbated underlying infrastructure problems
reporting_angles: Inspect streets across Sunnyside and Woodside to document potholes, cracks, and hazards; compare photos with DOT maintenance records
Interview residents about commuting/safety impacts; file FOIL for DOT repair schedules and budgets for this district

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints skyrocketed 3,900% over two weeks ago (5 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly baseline), with a z-score of 14.74, indicating a coordinated or sudden campaign of unauthorized signage that warrants urgent investigation.
evidence: 5 illegal posting complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (3,900% spike, z-score: 14.74—highest statistical anomaly in dataset)
Extreme z-score suggests either coordinated illegal advertising or a data reporting change that needs clarification
No Reddit discussion or news mentions of illegal posting campaign, suggesting story may be breaking
reporting_angles: Canvas neighborhoods for visible illegal signage and photograph locations; determine if it's gang tagging, commercial advertising, or political campaign
Contact NYPD and Sanitation Department to ask what triggered the spike and whether enforcement action is underway

themes_detail.label: Encampment Surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 22 LAST WEEK—a 376% spike from the 4.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.42)—signaling a rapid increase in homeless camps or informal settlements in public spaces that likely intersects with heat/housing pressures.
evidence: 22 encampment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.6 weekly average (376% increase, z-score: 4.42)
Heat/hot water complaints remain elevated at 1,746 over 90 days (2nd highest complaint category), suggesting housing instability
Community board budget repeatedly requests new/expanded parks and senior centers—infrastructure gaps that may contribute to street encampments
reporting_angles: Visit reported encampment locations; interview residents and service providers about scale, duration, and barriers to shelter access
Research DHS capacity in Queens CD 402; cross-check with NYC Homeless Services data on placements and bed availability in Sunnyside/Woodside

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Vehicle Backlog
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned vehicle complaints nearly doubled to 48 LAST WEEK—a 108% spike from the 23.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.76)—suggesting a breakdown in city towing and inventory management or an influx of junk vehicles.
evidence: 48 abandoned vehicle complaints LAST WEEK vs. 23.1 weekly average (108% increase, z-score: 4.76)
Illegal parking remains the top 311 complaint category at 5,616 over 90 days, indicating chronic parking/vehicle enforcement issues
Abandoned vehicles compound existing street quality problems and suggest neglected public space management
reporting_angles: Document abandoned vehicles on streets with photos and VIN numbers; file FOIL for NYPD/Sanitation tow records for this district
Interview residents about impact on parking availability and street aesthetics; check if tow capacity or funding shortfalls are constraining removals

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions & Pests
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about unsanitary conditions on private animal property spiked to 3 THIS WEEK—a 1,100% increase from the 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.35)—alongside elevated street sweeping complaints (3 last week vs. 0.2 avg), indicating emerging sanitation and pest control failures.
evidence: Unsanitary animal property complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1,100% increase, z-score: 6.35)
Street sweeping complaints also jumped to 3 LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 average (1,100% increase, z-score: 6.35)
Unsanitary conditions rank 10th in total 90-day complaints (259), but recent acceleration suggests emerging problem that could worsen
reporting_angles: Visit areas with high street sweeping and unsanitary condition complaints; photograph conditions and interview residents about rodents or sanitation gaps
Contact Sanitation Department to ask if collection schedules or staffing have changed; verify private property inspection procedures
